method: Conservative provisional evidence/readiness review; not a legal certification or an audit of a named district. A 2 requires the full descriptor and relevant operating evidence. Missing evidence is treated as partial where specific controls and commitments exist, rather than inferred as verified.

public.scope: Public SplatWorks.org / DrawSplat.org, supervised browser-only baseline; optional AI/cloud/SSO/backends off. Public hosting and external resource requests remain in scope.

district.scope: Self-hosted ecosystem with district MariaDB/MySQL classroom services; external services off unless separately approved. No particular district installation has been audited.

categories.rationale: Controls and deadlines exist; an end-to-end assisted request rehearsal covering all record locations is not evidenced.
Schedules and deletion tools exist; enabled expiry, external copies and backup destruction/restore evidence remain deployment dependent.
Local workflows and optional connections; published no-sale, no-targeted-advertising, no-profiling and no-training restrictions. Optional processing is excluded from these scopes.
Public inventory, hosting boundaries, dates and provider register are published. A particular district must add exact processing/log/backup locations and configuration.
Public HTTPS/headers and district security controls are documented; actual endpoint/database/object/backup encryption and incident operations are not fully evidenced.
Age bands and school/parent pathways are documented; ecosystem-wide operational consent/age enforcement is not demonstrated.
Dated provider register and notice/objection process exist; complete enabled resource/provider inventory, executed terms and flow-down evidence remain pending.
